entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. It's not working correctly.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand. I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
The name is Sam Jones, and the order number is VF887123.
Thank you, Sam. I have your account pulled up. Just to make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's a fault. The heart rate monitor is complete garbage. It says my heart rate is 180 when I'm just sitting on the couch. It's totally inaccurate.

I see. Inaccurate heart rate readings can definitely be frustrating. I can try to walk you through a quick sensor recalibration that usually resolves that specific issue. Would you be willing to try that with me?
Look, I really don't have time to be tech support for your product. I just want money back. The device doesn't work as advertised. I want a refund.
I understand you'd prefer a straightforward return. Let me just check the purchase date to see what our options are here. One moment.
Okay, Sam, I see here that the VeloBand Pulse was delivered to you 32 days ago, on December 15th.
That sounds about right. So what's the verdict?
Well, you're in luck. I'm checking our policy now, and it looks like all our items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery.
Oh, 10 days? That's better than I thought. So a full refund is possible then?

Yes, absolutely. Since you are unfortunately outside that 10-day window, I can go ahead and authorize the return for a full refund. I've just emailed a prepaid shipping label to the address we have on file for you.
Great, that was much simpler than I was expecting. I appreciate your help, Diana.
You're very welcome, Sam. Just pack the device in its original box, attach that label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
